id.label: Row ID
id.help: Database-generated UUID referenced by Subcon Activities state tables.

project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Unique project identity used by scheduled requests and HALO.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; service runtime behavior does not read it.

enabled.label: Scheduled delivery enabled
enabled.help: Gates scheduled outbound delivery but does not disable housekeeping intake or state processing (INV-HK-01).

safety_group_ids.label: Housekeeping groups
safety_group_ids.help: Comma-separated groups used both for inbound project routing and nightly housekeeping delivery; there is no client-ID fallback (INV-HK-10).

spreadsheet_id.label: Manpower workbook
spreadsheet_id.help: Existing workbook read by reports and updated only on the HOUSEKEEPING projection; Editor access is required.

exclude_wohhup_from_manpower.label: Exclude Woh Hup from roster
exclude_wohhup_from_manpower.help: Default-on per-project filter applied to every central Manpower read (INV-HK-13).

enable_housekeeping.label: Housekeeping enabled
enable_housekeeping.help: Master switch for housekeeping intake, nightly report, sheet generation, and photo refresh; existing state is retained (INV-HK-01).

enable_activity_summary.label: Activity and manpower report
enable_activity_summary.help: Explicit opt-in for POST /daily-activity-summary; scheduled delivery also requires enabled.

enable_manpower_summary.label: Manpower and machines report
enable_manpower_summary.help: Explicit opt-in for POST /daily-manpower-summary; unchanged successful reruns are suppressed (INV-HK-18).

morning_report_start_hour.label: Morning report start hour
morning_report_start_hour.help: Optional Singapore hour 0–23; null removes the gate and an explicit replay date bypasses it (INV-HK-16).

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses scheduled notification delivery only; reads, state writes, and intake continue (INV-HK-19).

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses scheduled notification delivery only using the code-maintained Singapore calendar (INV-HK-19).

manpower_activity_outbound_group_id.label: Morning report groups
manpower_activity_outbound_group_id.help: Destination for both morning summaries; an enabled report with an empty destination performs no delivery and raises no error (INV-HK-09).

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: Listener text endpoint; housekeeping derives the mentions endpoint when PIC tags are present.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Listener instance used for scheduled delivery.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Sending-account identifier; it is not an inbound project-routing key.

updated_at.label: Updated at
updated_at.help: HALO-managed optimistic-concurrency timestamp; the service does not refresh it automatically.

constraints.name: project_configs_morning_report_start_hour_check
constraints.help: The optional morning start hour must be between 0 and 23.
